svg.title: RapiMock answering requests
svg.desc: Four requests to RapiMock: a POST creates Biscuit and stores it, a GET lists it, a POST missing a required field gets 400, and a DELETE with a token lacking the pets:write scope gets 403.
svg.text: Seeded from the spec · kept until you reset
› Each API under its own path: localhost:4010/<api id>
› Reset the data: POST /__mock/reset · look inside: /__mock/ui
